beats.say: Patrick Stewart passed away on 28 October 2026 after a legendary career.
Born in Mirfield on 13 July 1940, he spent 86 years dedicated to his craft.
That is a lifetime longer than the entire history of televised colour broadcasts.
Many expected the Shakespearean icon to finish on the stage or in Star Trek.
However, his final performance actually took place within the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
The real reason he chose this path was his work on Avengers: Doomsday.
It capped a four year run in the franchise that began in 2022.
His knighthood in 2010 honoured his drama, but his final bow was pure blockbuster.
